tasks.task: Fix: Mount opencode.json to runtime container
tasks.notes: Fixed in docker-compose.yml: Added volume mount .agent-config/opencode.json → /root/.config/opencode/opencode.json. Removed hardcoded OPENCODE_MODEL env var. Need to rebuild runtime container to apply.

technical_details.error: No response received from the AI model
technical_details.root_cause: docker-compose.yml runtime service has wrong volumes. Only Skills folder is mounted, but .agent-config/opencode.json (with Mistral API key) is NOT mounted to /root/.config/opencode/opencode.json. Additionally OPENCODE_MODEL env var is hardcoded to opencode/glm-4.7-free.
technical_details.solution_needed: 1) Mount .agent-config/opencode.json to runtime container, 2) Remove hardcoded OPENCODE_MODEL env var

features.review_message: CORRECTED: Root cause is missing volume mount in docker-compose.yml, not bridge.ts. The opencode.json file with Mistral API key exists but is not mounted to the runtime container.
